purpose: Freeze the sole future Lane-9 CF4 development decode and score before any scientific row opens. This packet binds the audited identifier split, implements pure-byte scientific parsers and the complete deterministic analysis surface, keeps validation, confirmation, and Pantheon+ hard-sealed, and cannot authorize itself.

canonical_paths.grammar: nonempty normalized POSIX repository-relative path; reject backslash, drive, root, empty component, dot, and dot-dot before path resolution
canonical_paths.containment: each original path component must exist and be nonsymlink; the resolved regular file must remain strictly beneath the physical repository root
canonical_paths.current_source_rule: source path strings are grammar-checked only; this contract build/check/status does not resolve, stat, hash, or open any scientific source
canonical_paths.bound_metadata_rule: release configs, code, tests, receipts, and the audited identifier artifacts are resolved canonically and hash-verified

strict_grammar.framing: exactly one terminal LF with optional single CR immediately before it; no embedded CR/LF; payload length exact
strict_grammar.I: full fixed-width token matches ASCII space-star optional-sign digit-plus space-star; no decimal, exponent, internal space, tab, or control
strict_grammar.F: full fixed-width token matches ASCII space-star optional-sign (digits-plus dot digits-star or dot digits-plus) space-star; decimal point mandatory; finite binary64 only
strict_grammar.A: printable ASCII 0x20..0x7e; strip trailing spaces only
strict_grammar.missing: all ASCII spaces; every frozen field is required so missing rejects
strict_grammar.row_failure: any malformed row aborts the complete future development run; no row is silently dropped

role_gate.payload_hash_binding: framed, payload, identifier-slice, and opaque-tail hashes and exact stream offsets must match the audited ID ledger before scientific parsing
role_gate.forbidden: no caller-supplied role can override SHA256(canonical 1PGC)

geometry_join.mask: 360x180 uint8; only values 0 or 1; index geometry-v3 mask_index
geometry_join.table1_key: (Cosmo,void) globally unique among Planck2018 rows before edge filtering
geometry_join.table2_key: (Cosmo,void,x,y,z,Rad) with Python binary64 equality; signed zeros equal; duplicate rejects
geometry_join.sphere_join: every Planck2018 table2 row must match one Planck2018 table1 row; edge=1 spheres counted then excluded; edge=0 spheres retained
geometry_join.coordinate_probe: every Planck2018 table1 x,y,z equals geometry-v3 radec_to_xyz(RAdeg,DEdeg,s) componentwise at atol=1e-8 h^-1 Mpc plus rtol=1e-9
geometry_join.units: divide retained VAST table2 x,y,z,Rad by h exactly once; geometry-v3 returns (z_D,D_path_hinv), then D_path_Mpc=D_path_hinv/h exactly once
geometry_join.direction: geometry-v3 radec_to_xyz(CF4 RAdeg,DEdeg,1.0); law-v4 normalizes exactly once for ray intersection; executor-v3 independently normalizes exactly once for nuisance design
geometry_join.observed_interval: if angular mask is true, [0,min(D_path_Mpc,radial_limit_hinv_Mpc/h)]; otherwise empty
geometry_join.void_intervals: law-v4 analytic ray-sphere intervals clipped to [0,D_path_Mpc], sorted and unioned; overlaps are never double-counted

eligibility.primary: development role, all parses and domains valid, angular mask true, 0<=D_path_hinv_Mpc<=332.3856506347656, and L_unobserved_Mpc<=1e-10
eligibility.partial_mask: retain every development ID and exact reason in the per-object ledger; never score it and never convert missing exposure to zero
eligibility.failure: parser, hash, duplicate, join, coordinate-probe, distance, finite-value, or solver failure aborts the entire run; eligibility exclusions are retained counterexamples rather than failures

likelihood.baseline: s_FLRW=log1p(z_D) from geometry-v3 inversion of CF4 Dist
likelihood.nuisance: exact executor-v3 nine-column a_D+bulk+STF-shear design, priors, normalize-once path, binary64 Cholesky, grid, ties, and one-sided statistic

countermodels.purpose: ordinary frozen FLRW plus radial, bulk-flow, and STF-shear baseline
one dominant structure rather than accumulated path

countermodels.exposure: L_void_Mpc permuted within exact distance strata

profile_and_permutation.profile: call exact executor-v3 profile_grid/profile_at_delta; delta_H=-20+0.25*k for k=0..160; null index 80; exact tie rule retained
profile_and_permutation.strata: sort primary development rows by (Dist binary64, canonical 1PGC integer), assign floor(10*rank/N)
profile_and_permutation.loop: for permutation 0..9999 and stratum 0..9 call generator.permutation(m_s) once; targets and source values are in canonical-ID order
profile_and_permutation.statistic: max(0,chi2_profile(0)-chi2_profile(best)) only when selected best delta_H>0, else 0
profile_and_permutation.countermodel_fit: C01..C03 use the same rows, response, uncertainty, nuisance, priors, grid, and tie rule; no alternate tuning and no extra permutation campaign

thresholds.REQUEST_VALIDATION: eligible count>=500, best_delta_H>0, observed one-sided statistic>0, and exact permutation p<=0.01
thresholds.COUNTERMODEL_DEGENERATE_ANOMALY: REQUEST_VALIDATION but PATH_ACCUMULATION_SPECIFIC false; still request validation and retain the degeneracy
thresholds.DIRECTIONAL_NEAR_MISS: not REQUEST_VALIDATION, best_delta_H>0, and p<=0.05; retain without automatic holdout opening
thresholds.OPPOSITE_SIGN_COUNTEREXAMPLE: best_delta_H<0; retain signed estimate and all diagnostics
thresholds.grid_boundary: a best value at +/-20 is labeled GRID_BOUNDARY and retained; it is not retuned and is not an automatic veto
thresholds.orthodoxy: no established-physics, novelty, or mechanism-consistency judgment changes these empirical labels

development_ledger.coverage: every development ID, primary or excluded

failures.rule: retain counts, IDs when authorized, stage and stable reason codes; never include raw validation/confirmation/Pantheon tokens

summary.rule: counts, roots, signed estimate, T, tail, p, countermodels, threshold labels, access accounting, and claim ceiling

receipt.rule: bind every artifact raw/content hash and all release-chain hashes

failure_transaction.staging: create one unique directory strictly under work/open-gravity-void-correlation-development-score-v1-staging
failure_transaction.promotion: write, fsync, close, hash, and validate every artifact in staging; atomically rename the complete staging directory to the absent final directory; never overwrite or merge
failure_transaction.cleanup: on any exception remove only the exact resolved staging directory after proving containment beneath the staging root
failure_transaction.failure_retention: atomically no-clobber a sanitized failure receipt under runs/gravity/open-gravity-void-correlation-development-score-v1-failures; retain stage, stable reason code, access counts, and already-authorized development IDs but no sealed scientific bytes
failure_transaction.restart: if final exists validate its receipt and return existing-identical; any mismatch blocks

claim_ceiling: A future pass can identify a development-only correlation or counterexample. It cannot establish a time-well mechanism, modified gravity, novelty, validation, confirmation, or publication readiness.
next_gate: A distinct agent must audit all bindings, parser isolation, role-before-science enforcement, geometry/eligibility formulas, exact inherited solver/permutation use, output schemas, thresholds, mutation closure, and failure cleanup. Only that audit may emit a receipt authorizing one development decode and score.
